description:
Join our wayward alien hero on a quest to discover new galaxies in his funky spaceship! Star Stream features a simple, one-touch control scheme: just swipe to travel between planets.

--- SWEET CUSTOMIZATION ---
Collect golden stars as you travel through space, then visit the shop between games to upgrade your spaceship. Discover powerups like Autopilot, Star Magnet, and Asteroid Armor, and find your favorite ship and trail.

--- SIMPLE AND CAPTIVATING GAMEPLAY ---
A good sense of timing and an accurate aim will take you far. Launch from one planet’s gravitational orbit to the next, steer clear of asteroids, and keep your battery charged.

--- RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK ---
Push further into space before your battery runs out. Complete missions for star rewards and chase your next personal best.

--- BEAUTIFUL ARTWORK ---
Explore colorful galaxies filled with distinctive planets, asteroids, and backgrounds, accompanied by the original techno soundtrack.

GAME FEATURES
• One-swipe flight and orbital movement
• Spaceships, trails, powerups, upgrades, and perks
• Original maps plus a new procedural mode
• Favorite maps you can save and replay exactly
• Missions and local high scores
• Optional flight tuning after all seven paid products have been purchased
• Saved progress
• Full-screen landscape play on iPhone and iPad
• Offline gameplay, no account required, and no ads

Earn stars through play. Optional in-app purchases offer five star packs and permanent Double Stars and Pink Stars perks. Restore permanent purchases from the shop. Purchases require an App Store connection.

Flight tuning unlocks after buying each of the seven optional products at least once on this device. Adjust speed, gravity, difficulty, rotation, and procedural map density. Purchase history and tuning are saved locally; consumed star packs cannot be restored after reinstalling.

A classic space adventure, revived for a new generation of iPhone and iPad.
promotionalText: Launch from planet to planet, collect stars, and unlock your next adventure. A classic space arcade game, revived for iPhone and iPad.
